body: Root cause: subject/<slug>/index.html is one directory deeper than leaf pages, so the bare <slug>/<file> relative img src (correct on the index) resolved to a nonexistent nested path. Fixed to an absolute /prompt-o-verse/ path, matching the href pattern already in the same template. Regression test added (checked actual resolved src, not just href). Rebuilt, restarted iduna.service, re-ran promptoverse-rerender against live data. Commit 4d0b39d.
title: Fixed broken image links on Prompt-o-verse subject pages
